def factor_overnight_intraday_volweight_60d(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    rev = -overnight_ret
    mom = intraday_ret
    vol_rev = rev.rolling(60, min_periods=1).std()
    vol_mom = mom.rolling(60, min_periods=1).std()
    inv_vol_rev = 1 / vol_rev.replace(0, np.nan)
    inv_vol_mom = 1 / vol_mom.replace(0, np.nan)
    total_inv_vol = inv_vol_rev + inv_vol_mom
    w_rev = inv_vol_rev / total_inv_vol
    w_mom = inv_vol_mom / total_inv_vol
    signal = w_rev * rev + w_mom * mom
    df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_volweight_60d"] = signal
    return df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_volweight_60d"]
